table.name: Has_Pet
table.purpose: Junction/ownership table linking students to their pets (many-to-one from students: a student can own several pets).

PetID.name: PetID
PetID.description: Identifier of the pet owned; references Pets.PetID.

StuID.name: StuID
StuID.description: Identifier of the student who owns the pet; references Student.StuID. Repeats when a student owns multiple pets.

table.name: Pets
table.purpose: Lookup/detail table of pets: one row per pet with its type, age and weight.

pet_age.name: pet_age
pet_age.description: Age of the pet in years (values 1-3).

weight.name: weight
weight.description: Weight of the pet, presumably in kilograms (values 9.3-13.4); exact unit not confirmed.

table.name: Student
table.purpose: Registry of students: one row per student with personal and academic attributes.

Advisor.name: Advisor
Advisor.description: Advisor identifier (faculty/staff ID); no join target found, so the referenced table is unresolved.

Age.name: Age
Age.description: Age of the student in years (16-27, mostly 18-20).

Major.name: Major
Major.description: Major encoded as a numeric code (e.g. 600, 550, 540); no lookup table present, so the code meanings are unresolved.

city_code.name: city_code
city_code.description: Three-letter city code of the student's home city (e.g. NYC, PIT, HKG, CHI, PHL).
